title: Fix a failing test in a small package without touching the tests

turns.prompt: There is a small Python package in {D}/slugkit. Run its tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from that directory, find the bug the failing test points at, fix it in the package code (do not change the tests), run the tests again and tell me what was wrong.
turns.verify: cd {D}/slugkit && out=$(python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3); echo "SHOW $out"; sha=$(sha256sum tests/test_slugify.py | cut -d' ' -f1); if echo "$out" | grep -q '^OK' && [ "$sha" = "$(cat ../.test_sha)" ]; then echo PASS; else echo "FAIL: tests=$(echo $out | tail -c 80) tests_unchanged=$([ "$sha" = "$(cat ../.test_sha)" ] && echo yes || echo no)"; fi
